source.severity_rule: Low: index < 100/3; Medium: 100/3 <= index < 200/3; High: index >= 200/3. Project-defined equal-third severity bins, not sensor ground-truth labels.
source.warning: Public publisher data, not independently verified Bengaluru sensor records. This is not the missing six-block project archive.

metrics.task: Next-day congestion class from the previous six consecutive daily observations; up to three days recursively. Source severity bins are project-defined, not sensor ground truth.

split.method: chronological by target date: 70% train, 15% validation, 15% test

lstm_contribution.note: Ablation: the same Random Forest trained without the LSTM forecast features. It shows how much the LSTM adds on this dataset; the hybrid must beat it by the acceptance margin to be used.

transfer_validation.reason: Transfer did not beat the majority baseline by the required margin, so it is disabled.

metrics.caveat: Offline evaluation on historical records. It does not prove reliable live performance.

experiment.preprocessing: Each expanding LSTM fold fits its own scaler. Training profiles use only earlier records.

checks.check: macro-F1 beats the best baseline (historical_profile) by at least 0.02
macro-F1 beats the Random Forest without LSTM features by at least 0.02 (the LSTM adds value)
accuracy is at least the majority-class baseline
every class with at least 5 test records is predicted correctly at least once
